description.zh:
自定义会话ID。

注意：PlatformSessionId和CustomSessionId必须二选一。 如果同时设置了两个参数，以PlatformSessionId为准。
description.en:
Custom session ID.

Note: PlatformSessionId and CustomSessionId are mutually exclusive. If both parameters are set, PlatformSessionId takes precedence.

description.zh:
平台会话ID，在平台中唯一标识一个会话。

注意：PlatformSessionId和CustomSessionId必须二选一。 如果同时设置了两个参数，以PlatformSessionId为准。
description.en:
Platform session ID, which uniquely identifies a session on the platform.

Note: PlatformSessionId and CustomSessionId are mutually exclusive. If both parameters are set, PlatformSessionId takes precedence.

description.en: 停止容器参数。此参数将透传到Agent。

description.zh:

description.en:
目前支持的枚举值包括：
- reason：停止原因。

descriptions.zh:
发起停止、程序主动停止或程序崩溃等原因导致应用程序停止后，会通过此消息通知。 事件类型为`APP_STOP`。 >仅限API对接模式，不适用于H5 SDK对接模式。 > |名称|类型|是否必选|说明| | ------ | ------ | ------ |------ | |success|Boolean|是|停止是否成功。
取值：
true：停止成功。
false：停止失败。| |eventType|String|是|事件类型。| |customSessionId|String|是|自定义会话ID。| |platformSessionId|String|是|平台会话ID。| |normal|Boolean|是|是否正常停止。
取值：
true：正常停止。
false：异常停止。| |eventDetail|Object[EventDetail]|否|事件详情，成功时返回。| |errorMessage|Object|否|错误详情，失败时返回。| EventDetail数据结构如下所示。 |名称|类型|是否必选|说明| |------|------|------|------| |appId|String|是|应用ID。| |appVersion|String|是|应用版本ID。| ErrorMessage数据结构如下所示。 |名称|类型|是否必选|说明| |------|------|------|------| |code|String|是|错误码。| |msg|String|是|错误详情。|
descriptions.en:
This message is sent to notify that the application has been stopped due to reasons such as an initiated stop request, the program actively stopping, or a program crash. The event type is `APP_STOP`. >Applies only to API integration mode and not to H5 SDK integration mode.> |Name|Type|Required|Description| | ------ | ------ | ------ |------ | |success|Boolean|Yes|Indicates whether the stop operation succeeded.
Possible values:
true: The stop operation succeeded.
false: The stop operation failed.| |eventType|String|Yes|Event type.| |customSessionId|String|Yes|Custom session ID.| |platformSessionId|String|Yes|Platform session ID.| |normal|Boolean|Yes|Indicates whether the application stopped normally.
Possible values:
true: Normal stop.
false: Abnormal stop.| |eventDetail|Object[EventDetail]|No|Event details, returned when the operation succeeds.| |errorMessage|Object|No|Error details, returned when the operation fails.| The EventDetail data structure is as follows: |Name|Type|Required|Description| |------|------|------|------| |appId|String|Yes|Application ID.| |appVersion|String|Yes|Application Version ID.| The ErrorMessage data structure is as follows: |Name|Type|Required|Description| |------|------|------|------| |code|String|Yes|Error code.| |msg|String|Yes|Error Details.|
